cad_frame_evidence: Front planar face centroid (421.513 mm2) and body-axis normal from STEP; tail fins visually inspected. Local +X points forward; origin is front-face center, not center of mass.
launch_evidence: Adjustable point in the named red launch-station opening. Height and local offset are demonstration assumptions, not a measured launcher muzzle.
target_evidence: Upper blue-base surface above the current green lamp, found by ray against the native visual mesh. This bounded patch is an approximate dart target, independent of the UAV lower armor; official dimensions and target identity are not certified.
flight_time_basis: Keep the reviewed launch and target fixed and set the world-Z apex to 5.0 m. In vacuum, duration is ascent sqrt(2*(apex-z0)/g) plus descent sqrt(2*(apex-z1)/g).
model: Analytic front-reference-point gravity-only parabola. CAD heading follows velocity visually. No drag, lift, attitude dynamics, deformation or rebound. Stop at target-plane intersection.
